subject: Regarding Your Recent Purchase
body: Dear Customer, Thank you for your recent purchase with our online store. We wanted to confirm that your order has been processed and is on its way to you. You can expect to receive a tracking number within the next 24 hours. If you have any questions or concerns about your order, please don't hesitate to contact our customer support team. We appreciate your business and hope you enjoy your new purchase. Best regards, The Customer Service Team
